These models represent our most advanced and intelligent systems to date, improving from our experience in building QwQ and Qwen2.5. sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Qwen3.5-0.8B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.
